purpose: Freeze two independently documented U.S. high-altitude balloon event dates inside the study window before inspecting Blue Book or POSS-I overlap. This is a positive-event calibration set, not a complete balloon-activity denominator.

events.location: Rapid City / Stratobowl, South Dakota, USA
events.authority: Naval History and Heritage Command / NARA image catalog
events.source_semantics: NHHC describes two naval observers ascending on 1956-11-08 in the Strato-Lab gondola to an unofficial altitude record of about 76,000 ft.

events.program: Low Altitude Project Task Hotel — Target Release Systems
events.authority: CIA FOIA declassified project progress letter
events.source_semantics: The project letter states that two successful test flights were conducted from Pierre, South Dakota on 1957-01-30, numbered 2096 and 2097.

population_boundary.forbidden_role: No rate, risk, enrichment, or no-balloon-day inference from absence outside these two dates.

bluebook_direct_attribution_requires: witness geography compatible with South Dakota launch/trajectory context
within-day ordering compatible when event times are available
narrative morphology not contradicting a balloon-like/high-altitude target explanation
poss_direct_attribution_requires: candidate morphology compatible with a moving/point-source human-made object after plate/exposure integration
